SELECT target.PRECEDENT_ID, target.CASE_NUMBER, target.COURT_NAME, target.RESULT_TYPE, target.CASE_TYPE, target.ACCIDENT_DISEASE_TYPE, target.TITLE, target.CONTENT, target.CONTENT_HASH
FROM ( SELECT precedent.PRECEDENT_ID, precedent.CASE_NUMBER, precedent.COURT_NAME, precedent.RESULT_TYPE, precedent.CASE_TYPE, precedent.ACCIDENT_DISEASE_TYPE, precedent.TITLE, precedent.CONTENT, precedent.CONTENT_HASH
FROM WC_PRECEDENT precedent
WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM WC_PRECEDENT_CHUNK chunk WHERE chunk.PRECEDENT_ID = precedent.PRECEDENT_ID )
ORDER BY precedent.PRECEDENT_ID ) target
WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit, jdbcType=INTEGER}
